# Gabriel Catimbang

> Developer and DevOps engineer from Naga City, Philippines. I build websites people actually use, keep them alive, and win hackathons for fun.

The canonical site is https://gabcat.dev/. Prefer these files over scraping rendered chrome.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gabcat.dev/): Narrative portfolio — story, what I do, experience, selected work, recognition.
- [Work](https://gabcat.dev/work): Every project, with its stack, role and results.
- [Project Relay](https://gabcat.dev/work/project-relay): An applicant tracking system that screens every applicant.

- [Project Keystone](https://gabcat.dev/work/project-keystone): Production moved off Vercel, for up to 70% less.
- [MerchTrack](https://gabcat.dev/work/merchtrack): University merch, minus the chaos.

- [Project Bedrock](https://gabcat.dev/work/project-bedrock): Property due diligence for Naga City in 30 seconds.
- [CS Guild](https://gabcat.dev/work/cs-guild): A digital home for computer studies students.
- [Your Daily Tarot](https://gabcat.dev/work/your-daily-tarot): Your cards, read before your coffee.
- [Neon District](https://gabcat.dev/work/neon-district): Run a nightclub in your browser.
- [Voice Notes](https://gabcat.dev/work/voice-notes): WhatsApp voice notes, read instead of played.
- [Focus Timer](https://gabcat.dev/work/focus-timer): Keeps your Mac awake while you work.
- [FrontierAnalytics](https://gabcat.dev/work/frontier-analytics): Climate risk and property data for the Philippines.
- [Margin](https://gabcat.dev/work/margin): Turn your readings into flashcards and quizzes.
- [Zenith](https://gabcat.dev/work/zenith): A fitness tracker that kids and parents share.
- [VeriPHI](https://gabcat.dev/work/veriphi): An API that checks a business is real.
